The beam swept past him into the fog, and for a moment he felt less alone, as if someone long gone had finally found a way to answer.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的安静里。高楼窗灯稀疏，像未睡的眼睛；湿滑的街道映着霓虹微光。便利店亮着暖黄的灯，环卫工的扫帚划过路面，发出沙沙声响。高架上偶有出租车驶过，红光一闪便消失在桥尽头。风带着凉意穿过楼宇，巷口面店还未开张。再过一会儿天光将醒，喧嚣会重新填满街道；此刻，城市只属于少数孤独的人。","w03":"- Recursion is when a task uses itself to solve a smaller version of the same task.\n- Each smaller version repeats until it reaches a simple stopping case that can be answered directly.\n- Then the smaller answers pass back upward, one step at a time, until the original task is solved."}
